# mergewf Provider

Manage Merge Workforce groups, people, tool access, skill access, and SCIM provisioning. Workforce organization keys and SCIM tokens are separate credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mergewf = {
      source = "bogware/mergewf"
    }
  }
}

# Set MERGEWF_API_KEY and, for SCIM, MERGEWF_SCIM_TOKEN in the environment.
provider "mergewf" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization API key. Defaults to MERGEWF_API_KEY. Required for /api/v1 operations; keys need both read and write scopes for managed resources.
- `base_url` (String) Workforce API origin. Defaults to MERGEWF_BASE_URL or https://wf-api.merge.dev. HTTP is allowed only for loopback fixture servers.
- `scim_token` (String, Sensitive) SCIM provisioning token. Defaults to MERGEWF_SCIM_TOKEN. Required for SCIM resources and data sources.
